mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ics30_start_date, ics30_date_fix_yn) AS compliance_id, ics30_start_date AS start_date, ics30_date_fix_yn AS date_fix_yn FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY ics30_start_date, ics30_date_fix_yn ORDER BY ics30_start_date DESC, ics30_date_fix_yn

WITH sys_code AS ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(b.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code b WHERE b.sys09_code_kind_id = a.sys09_code_kind_id AND b.sys09_company_id = a.sys09_company_id AND b.sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND b.sys09_apply_date <= #{startDate} ) AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= #{startDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ) SELECT ics30_compliance_id AS compliance_id, ics30_company_id AS company_id, ics30_start_date AS start_date, ics30_compliance_type AS compliance_type, sys09_name AS compliance_type_name, ics30_sub_num AS sub_num, ics30_content AS content, ics30_na_use_yn AS na_use_yn, ics30_use_yn AS use_yn, ics30_use_close_date AS use_close_date, ics30_note AS note, ics30_date_fix_yn AS date_fix_yn FROM ics30_compliance INNER JOIN sys_code ON sys09_code = ics30_compliance_type WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics30_start_date = #{startDate} ORDER BY COALESCE(sys09_seq, sys09_code), ics30_sub_num

SELECT ics30_compliance_id AS compliance_id, ics30_company_id AS company_id, ics30_start_date AS start_date, ics30_compliance_type AS compliance_type, f_cdnm('IcsComplianceType', ics30_compliance_type, ics30_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS compliance_type_name, ics30_sub_num AS sub_num, ics30_content AS content, ics30_na_use_yn AS na_use_yn, ics30_use_yn AS use_yn, ics30_use_close_date AS use_close_date, ics30_note AS note, ics30_date_fix_yn AS date_fix_yn FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics30_start_date <= f_today() ) AND ics30_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics30_compliance ( ics30_compliance_id, ics30_company_id, ics30_start_date, ics30_compliance_type, ics30_sub_num, ics30_content, ics30_na_use_yn, ics30_use_yn, ics30_use_close_date, ics30_note, ics30_date_fix_yn ) VALUES ( #{complianceId}, #{companyId}, #{startDate}, #{complianceType}, #{subNum}, #{content}, #{naUseYn}, #{useYn}, #{useCloseDate}, #{note}, #{dateFixYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT ics33_compliance_answer_id AS compliance_answer_id, ics33_company_id AS company_id, ics33_start_date AS start_date, ics33_compliance_type AS compliance_type, ics33_case_no AS case_no, ics33_answer1_cd AS answer1_cd, f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics33_answer1_cd, ics33_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS answer1_name, ics33_answer2_cd AS answer2_cd, f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics33_answer2_cd, ics33_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS answer2_name, ics33_answer3_cd AS answer3_cd, f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics33_answer3_cd, ics33_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS answer3_name, ics33_answer4_cd AS answer4_cd, f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics33_answer4_cd, ics33_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS answer4_name, ics33_answer5_cd AS answer5_cd, f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics33_answer5_cd, ics33_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS answer5_name FROM ics33_compliance_answer WHERE ics33_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics33_start_date = #{startDate} AND ics33_compliance_type = #{complianceType} ORDER BY ics33_case_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics33_compliance_answer ( ics33_compliance_answer_id, ics33_company_id, ics33_start_date, ics33_compliance_type, ics33_case_no, ics33_answer1_cd, ics33_answer2_cd, ics33_answer3_cd, ics33_answer4_cd, ics33_answer5_cd ) VALUES ( #{row.complianceAnswerId}, #{companyId}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.complianceType}, #{row.caseNo}, #{row.answer1Cd}, #{row.answer2Cd}, #{row.answer3Cd}, #{row.answer4Cd}, #{row.answer5Cd} )
